name: vigil-clm
description: Vigil — self-hosted Certificate Lifecycle Management with OpenSSL-powered, reference-driven renewals.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
